decisions.title: Audit location effects are presented as live discovery despite owner-only confirmation
decisions.note: Defer to Step 4; no artifact edit, so pass 4 stays valid. Both ALZ-lite location effects (Audit) were verified live on 2026-10-06 with the owner's az policy assignment show at mg-factory-corp, not from discovery. Evidence supplied by the owner: {"displayName":"ALZ-lite: Allowed locations","effect":"Audit","enforcementMode":"Default"} and {"displayName":"ALZ-lite: Audit resource location matches resource group location","effect":"Audit","enforcementMode":"Default"}. 04-governance-constraints.md already says Audit for both (owner-confirmed). Discovery does not itemize Audit effects or allowed locations; no allow-list is claimed. Step 4 cites that command as the evidence. Evidence is owner-run output; 04g-Governance did not run it (az policy reads are outside its deterministic-discovery scope).

decisions.title: Filtered Defender assignments are called non-blocking without effect-level evidence
decisions.note: Defer to Step 4; no artifact edit, so pass 4 stays valid. Evidence recorded 2026-10-06 from the deterministic discovery script run to a scratch path with Defender auto-assignments retained (the governance files were not changed; hash verified). Three Defender for Cloud automatic assignments, all at the workload subscription scope, enforcement mode Default: (1) ASC DataProtection, 3 policies: Defender for SQL managed instances, SQL servers, Synapse SQL, all deployIfNotExists; (2) ASC OpenSourceRelationalDatabasesProtection, 5 policies: Advanced Threat Protection for MariaDB, MySQL (single and flexible) and PostgreSQL (single and flexible), all deployIfNotExists; (3) Defender for SQL Servers on Machines provisioning, 3 policies: SQL VM identity and Defender for SQL extension, all deployIfNotExists. 11 policies in total, none with a Deny effect; blocker_count stays 19. The only one touching an archetype resource type is the Defender for SQL managed instances configuration (DeployIfNotExists enabling a protection plan, not a Deny). Verified non-blocking.
